name: 1pcs Beauty Glazed Soft Eyeliner Pencil White
description:
Soft brushstrokes, close to eye skin 

Easy to paint, waterproof and durable, easy to paint a variety of delicate makeup 

A multi-use, can do eyeliner, eyeshadow pen, highlighter, open eye makeup, lip highlight and so on 

The pen refill is wrapped in high quality wood. If the refill becomes short, use a pencil sharpener to cut 1-2 turns 



Product efficacy: 



Slim eyes, use silver to describe the inner liner, has the effect of increasing the white of the eyes, slim eyes 

Charming peach eyes, using a pen to depict the lying silkworm and then with pink eyeshadow, charming index rises straight 

Lift your lips and use a silver-white highlighter to outline your lips, making them fuller and more three-dimensional 

Personality eye makeup, enlarge eyes, enhance aura, personality explosion
